purpose: Strengthen quantity/topology separation by matching the multiset of all canonical target-query 2x2 contingency profiles at finite exact-balanced scopes.
matching_definition: Canonical binary target-query contingency profiles are compared up to independent 0/1 relabeling. Equality therefore implies equal pairwise mutual information/association strength profiles as a multiset, not name-by-name equality.

depth_2.interpretation: Pairwise target-information strength distribution can be held fixed while strict adaptive gain is removed.

depth_3.interpretation: Pairwise target-information strength distribution remains matched while the control becomes a three-query no-gain task, versus the routeable family's much larger fixed burden.

claim_boundary: The pairwise match is a multiset match, not a name-by-name target-query match.
These are finite registered controls at routing depths 2 and 3; no asymptotic pairwise-matched control family is claimed.
The stronger asymptotic quantity/topology theorem instead matches the full cue-only environment, target prevalence/entropy, and total full-vocabulary target information.
